text:
Use with caution / monitor

Rifampin is a potent inducer of cytochrome P450 enzymes, including CYP2C9, 1A2, and 3A4 [rifampin:drug_interactions:1, warfarin:drug_interactions:2]. Because warfarin is metabolized by these same isozymes, concurrent administration with rifampin increases warfarin metabolism and decreases its exposure in the body [warfarin:drug_interactions:2]. This reduction in warfarin levels has the potential to decrease its therapeutic effect and lower the INR [warfarin:drug_interactions:2].
